title: Business Development Analyst (Hospitality & Asset Management)
description:
### **Responsibilities**



a { text\-decoration: none; color: \#464feb; } tr th, tr td { border: 1px solid \#e6e6e6; } tr th { background\-color: \#f5f5f5; }


**1\. Market Research \& Competitor Intelligence**


* Conduct comprehensive market assessments, including demand–supply analysis, industry trend tracking, and competitive benchmarking across target geographies.
* Evaluate hotel performance indicators, tourism dynamics, macroeconomic factors, and market opportunities to inform business development strategies.
* Develop insightful analytical reports, dashboards, and market intelligence summaries to support asset management and strategic decision\-making.


**2\. Financial Modeling \& Business Case Development**


* Build detailed financial models covering partnerships, operator assessments, feasibility studies, and investment proposals.
* Perform scenario modelling, ROI evaluation, NPV/IRR calculations, cash flow forecasting, and sensitivity analysis to assess project viability.
* Support the Lead – Business Development in preparing investment memos, business cases, and strategic evaluation presentations.


**3\. Deal Assessment \& Structuring Support**


* Assist in evaluating operator proposals, including management contracts, franchise agreements, lease structures, and alternative partnership models.
* Contribute to the structuring of deals that align with the company’s strategic, commercial, and financial objectives.
* Benchmark operator performance, commercial terms, fee structures, and assess their impact on long\-term asset returns.


**4\. Proposal Development \& Documentation**


* Prepare high\-quality pitch decks, financial summaries, opportunity proposals, and partnership evaluation documents.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams—including legal, finance, commercial, and operations—to gather inputs and validate assumptions.
* Ensure clarity, precision, and strategic alignment in all documents prepared for leadership review and external partners.


**5\. Support in Commercial Negotiations**


* Analyze commercial terms, financial implications, and risk–return outcomes to support negotiations with operators and strategic partners.
* Provide benchmarking insights, analytical assessments, and data\-driven recommendations during negotiation discussions.
* Track commercial commitments, performance KPIs, and financial obligations to ensure effective governance and compliance post\-deal.


**6\. Portfolio Performance Monitoring**


* Support monitoring of hospitality asset performance, including revenue trends, cost drivers, operator efficiency, and contractual compliance.
* Identify opportunities for commercial enhancement and operational improvements across the portfolio.
* Prepare periodic portfolio performance reports and strategic insights for senior leadership.

### **Qualifications**


**Essential Qualifications**


* MBA or equivalent postgraduate degree preferred.
* Relevant experience in:


Hospitality business analysis


* Hotel development
* Financial analysis
* Consulting
* Asset management


**Work Experience**


* **Total Experience Required:** 8–12 years
* **Preferred Background:**


Organizations in the **Real Estate (Hospitality segment)**


* **International hotel brands** or similar environments


**Applicable Sectors:**


* Hospitality
* Real Estate
* Any related sector with relevant experience

title: National Sales Manager
description:
**Company Description**  

Syngenta Seeds is one of the world’s largest developers and producers of seed for farmers, commercial growers, retailers and small seed companies. Syngenta seeds improve the quality and yields of crops. High\-quality seeds ensure better and more productive crops, which is why farmers invest in them. Advanced seeds help mitigate risks such as disease and drought and allow farmers to grow food using less land, less water and fewer inputs.


Syngenta Seeds brings farmers more vigorous, stronger, resistant plants, including innovative hybrid varieties and biotech crops that can thrive even in challenging growing conditions.


Syngenta Seeds is headquartered in the United States.

 **Job Description** **Role Purpose**

* Manage and drive the Country P\&L (in terms of Volume, Revenue, and Margins); and NPL as a percentage of Sales
* Identify new areas of growth, evaluate alternate business models to drive future growth
* Manage Sales Fixed Costs and Business Quality thru’ optimising Sales returns \& Collections
* Lead and Motivate the Sales Leadership team of Division Managers to execute sales campaigns \& Business delivery in accordance with the Field Crops Sales Execution Strategy
* Contribute and adhere to the Syngenta commercial policies and pricing structures
* Explore alternate distribution models by Identifying opportunities with strategic partners
* Assume external relationship responsibilities and create a conducive environments for “License To Operate” for the divisions with local regulators and industry stakeholders
* Collaborate with Key stakeholders (Agronomy, Marketing, P\&S and R\&D)
* Act as a single contact point for Monthly Sales Outlooks, Sales \& Operations Plans, Year End Estimates, Sales Execution Strategy and People related matters for alignment in line with overall FC Business aspirations under the direction of the Business Head
* Enable and Coach the Division Managers and High Potential Business Managers
* Develop and maintain a high\-performing Sales organization

* Holistic **ownership of the Country Business Objectives**
	+ Including commercial performance, customer experience, team engagement, external stakeholder commitments
* Create and **execute plan for business delivery**
	+ Focus on sales, profitability, liquidation, collections, market share
* De\-risk business through **contingency plans** and **new opportunities**
	+ Monitor and drive performances of Channel partners (Distributors, Retailers)
	+ Evaluate, assess and expand the Syngenta Pramukh network
* Strong rigour in **scale up of New Products through** Post Season activity drive and channel engagement in selected blocks
* **Lead, Coach** and **Motivate** Division Managers to achieve Division objectives

* Actively manage value chain and cross\-functional stakeholders
* Actively manage **industry and government relationships**
* Ensure Team participation to upgrade **Digital Fluency**
* **Develop Sales and Marketing excellence** throughout the Syngenta Enterprise

	+ Develop plans to fill gaps
	+ Provide best\-in\-class Commercial training to the commercial functions to build and maintain status as trusted local expert.
	+ Keep track of developments in agriculture, systematically capture information and bring new innovations to farmers for a competitive advantage.
* **Collaborate with key stakeholders** for sustainable Business growth:
	+ Corporate Marketing for aligning with Product, Pricing and Promotion Strategies
	+ Commercial Excellence team for Block strategy, Customer Insights and Channel performance metrics
	+ R\&D and Agronomy for faster product delivery in gap segments
	+ P\&S and Logistics teams to monitor supply and dispatch plans
	+ Finance teams for streamlining Business reports
	+ HR team for managing Team capabilities, Policies and People Processes
* **People Development**
	+ Identify talent, recruit, develop, motivate, and provide growth opportunities to team members. Develop performance management plans.
	+ Actively manage any performance issues within the team by regular feedback and coaching.
	+ Identify technical and people leaders and provide them appropriate opportunities for development and succession planning.
	+ Ensure workplace safety and compliance to Syngenta ESH policies
	+ Actively demonstrate **Syngenta Values** and coach team members.
* Active participation in the Field Crops Leadership Team, Sales Leadership Team, HPCs and Division Leadership meetings to ensure alignment and execution of the Sales Strategy in line with country goals, and input into annual and long\-range plans.

  

**Qualifications** **Knowledge, Experience \& Capabilities**

**Critical knowledge**

* E2E Business Understanding – Commercial, Agronomy, P\&S, R\&D
* Strategic Decision Making and Entrepreneur Mindset
* Expertise in Sales Management, People Management and Building Winning Teams
* Project management capability
* Seed and CP business acumen \- understanding of commercial, Agronomy, Logistics and Distribution
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.

**Critical experience**

* 10\-15 years of Sales \& Marketing experience in Agricultural or related fields
* Experience in developing teams and participation in strategic teams
* Demonstrated people management potential and coaching others to success

**Critical technical, professional and personal capabilities**

* Excellent organization and leadership skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Business and Finacial acumen
* Strong interpersonal communication and influencing (with or without authority) skills to work across numerous internal multidisciplinary groups, including Research, Supply chain, Production, Agronomy, Commercial, Regulatory, Intellectual property, etc.

* Analytical and strategic skills
* Decision making skills

**Critical leadership capabilities**

* Result Orientation thru’ Growth Mindset

**Critical Success Factors \& Key Challenges**

title: Digital Sales Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities:

**Drive digital sales for the Subscription business and own the overall revenue target across online channels.**  Plan and run sales communication across the website, email campaigns, and WhatsApp to drive new sign\-ups and renewals.

**Build a clear client segmentation approach so that the right message reaches the right user at the right time.**  Manage the systems and processes used for digital sales – ad servers, email platforms, and WhatsApp tools – and work with partners to keep them running smoothly.

**Market internal products across social media platforms and partner databases; identify and close B2B subscription deals with brokers, distributors, and corporate partners.**  Identify and execute cross\-sell opportunities across PMS, Investment Advisory, Research Analyst, and Subscription businesses to grow value from the same client.

**Work closely with the Design, Technology, and Product teams to deliver landing pages, campaigns, and product nudges that improve conversions.**  Track campaign performance, share regular updates with leadership, and continuously test and improve what works.

**Manage the digital sales budget and ensure efficient use of marketing spend. Key Requirements:**  2\+ years of experience in digital sales, preferably in financial services, wealth management, broking, or fintech.

**MBA preferred from a reputed institute.**  Experience in digital sales of financial products is essential; preferred experience in digital sales of a subscription business.

**Proven ability to promote and manage sales communication across websites, email campaigns, and WhatsApp.**  Good understanding of client segmentation and how to use it to drive better sales outcomes.

**Deep understanding of systems and processes related to ad servers, email servers, and WhatsApp servers.**  Experience marketing internal products across social media platforms and databases, and the ability to close B2B subscription deals.

**Strong team player – comfortable working closely with Design, Technology, and Product teams.**  Good understanding of cross\-sell opportunities across multiple businesses to the same client.

**Good understanding of capital markets and investment products (PMS, Mutual Funds, Subscription, Advisory) is an added advantage.**  Good verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi; regional language proficiency is a plus.
